evidence.title: What is the Live Agent Studio?

name: ottomator-agents
summary: Repository of the source code and n8n workflow JSON for the AI agents hosted on the oTTomator Live Agent Studio.
description: The Live Agent Studio is a community platform where every hosted agent is open sourced here as Python code or n8n workflow JSON. The repository includes sample agents and a developer guide for building and submitting your own; agents cover many use cases and run on the platform with tokens.
contains: source code and workflow JSON for the agents hosted on the Live Agent Studio
n8n and Python sample agents as starting points
developer guide for building and submitting agents
agents are open source; the platform is community-driven and in beta
using agents on the platform costs tokens, with free tokens on first sign-in
